paragraphs.text: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
paragraphs.original: τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν· στήκετε οὖν καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε.
paragraphs.translit: tē eleutheria hēmas Christos ēleutherōsen· stēkete oun kai mē palin zygō douleias enechesthe.

paragraphs.text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
paragraphs.original: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὑμᾶς οὐδὲν ὠφελήσει.
paragraphs.translit: Ide egō Paulos legō hymin hoti ean peritemnēsthe Christos hymas ouden ōphelēsei.

paragraphs.text: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
paragraphs.original: μαρτύρομαι δὲ πάλιν παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ὀφειλέτης ἐστὶν ὅλον τὸν νόμον ποιῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: martyromai de palin panti anthrōpō peritemnomenō hoti opheiletēs estin holon ton nomon poiēsai.

paragraphs.text: Ye are severed from Christ, ye would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.
paragraphs.original: κατηργήθητε ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ οἵτινες ἐν νόμῳ δικαιοῦσθε, τῆς χάριτος ἐξεπέσατε.
paragraphs.translit: katērgēthēte apo Christou hoitines en nomō dikaiousthe, tēs charitos exepesate.

paragraphs.text: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς γὰρ πνεύματι ἐκ πίστεως ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis gar pneumati ek pisteōs elpida dikaiosynēs apekdechometha.

paragraphs.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.
paragraphs.original: ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή τι ἰσχύει οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ πίστις διʼ ἀγάπης ἐνεργουμένη.
paragraphs.translit: en gar Christō Iēsou oute peritomē ti ischyei oute akrobystia, alla pistis diʼ agapēs energoumenē.

paragraphs.text: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
paragraphs.original: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς· τίς ὑμᾶς ἐνέκοψεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι;
paragraphs.translit: Etrechete kalōs· tis hymas enekopsen tē alētheia mē peithesthai;

paragraphs.text: This persuasion [came] not of him that calleth you.
paragraphs.original: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: hē peismonē ouk ek tou kalountos hymas.

paragraphs.text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
paragraphs.original: μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ.
paragraphs.translit: mikra zymē holon to phyrama zymoi.

paragraphs.text: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ πέποιθα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι οὐδὲν ἄλλο φρονήσετε· ὁ δὲ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα, ὅστις ἐὰν ᾖ.
paragraphs.translit: egō pepoitha eis hymas en kyriō hoti ouden allo phronēsete· ho de tarassōn hymas bastasei to krima, hostis ean ē.

paragraphs.text: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ δέ, ἀδελφοί, εἰ περιτομὴν ἔτι κηρύσσω, τί ἔτι διώκομαι; ἄρα κατήργηται τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: egō de, adelphoi, ei peritomēn eti kēryssō, ti eti diōkomai; ara katērgētai to skandalon tou staurou.

paragraphs.text: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.
paragraphs.original: ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: ophelon kai apokopsontai hoi anastatountes hymas.

paragraphs.text: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only [use] not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
paragraphs.original: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ ἐπʼ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἐκλήθητε, ἀδελφοί· μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί, ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις·
paragraphs.translit: Hymeis gar epʼ eleutheria eklēthēte, adelphoi· monon mē tēn eleutherian eis aphormēn tē sarki, alla dia tēs agapēs douleuete allēlois·

paragraphs.text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
paragraphs.original: ὁ γὰρ πᾶς νόμος ἐν ἑνὶ λόγῳ πεπλήρωται, ἐν τῷ· Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.
paragraphs.translit: ho gar pas nomos en heni logō peplērōtai, en tō· Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton.

paragraphs.text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε, βλέπετε μὴ ὑπʼ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: ei de allēlous daknete kai katesthiete, blepete mē hypʼ allēlōn analōthēte.

paragraphs.text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
paragraphs.original: Λέγω δέ, πνεύματι περιπατεῖτε καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς οὐ μὴ τελέσητε.
paragraphs.translit: Legō de, pneumati peripateite kai epithymian sarkos ou mē telesēte.

paragraphs.text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.
paragraphs.original: ἡ γὰρ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός, ταῦτα γὰρ ἀλλήλοις ἀντίκειται, ἵνα μὴ ἃ ἐὰν θέλητε ταῦτα ποιῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: hē gar sarx epithymei kata tou pneumatos, to de pneuma kata tēs sarkos, tauta gar allēlois antikeitai, hina mē ha ean thelēte tauta poiēte.

paragraphs.text: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ πνεύματι ἄγεσθε, οὐκ ἐστὲ ὑπὸ νόμον.
paragraphs.translit: ei de pneumati agesthe, ouk este hypo nomon.

paragraphs.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are [these]: fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
paragraphs.original: φανερὰ δέ ἐστιν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός, ἅτινά ἐστιν πορνεία, ἀκαθαρσία, ἀσέλγεια,
paragraphs.translit: phanera de estin ta erga tēs sarkos, hatina estin porneia, akatharsia, aselgeia,

paragraphs.text: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,
paragraphs.original: εἰδωλολατρία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις,
paragraphs.translit: eidōlolatria, pharmakeia, echthrai, eris, zēlos, thymoi, eritheiai, dichostasiai, haireseis,

paragraphs.text: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which I forewarn you, even as I did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
paragraphs.original: φθόνοι, μέθαι, κῶμοι, καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις, ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: phthonoi, methai, kōmoi, kai ta homoia toutois, ha prolegō hymin kathōs proeipon hoti hoi ta toiauta prassontes basileian theou ou klēronomēsousin.

paragraphs.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
paragraphs.original: Ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη, χαρά, εἰρήνη, μακροθυμία, χρηστότης, ἀγαθωσύνη, πίστις,
paragraphs.translit: Ho de karpos tou pneumatos estin agapē, chara, eirēnē, makrothymia, chrēstotēs, agathōsynē, pistis,

paragraphs.text: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
paragraphs.original: πραΰτης, ἐγκράτεια· κατὰ τῶν τοιούτων οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος.
paragraphs.translit: prautēs, enkrateia· kata tōn toioutōn ouk estin nomos.

paragraphs.text: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de tou Christou tēn sarka estaurōsan syn tois pathēmasin kai tais epithymiais.

paragraphs.text: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ζῶμεν πνεύματι, πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν.
paragraphs.translit: ei zōmen pneumati, pneumati kai stoichōmen.

paragraphs.text: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
paragraphs.original: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι, ἀλλήλους προκαλούμενοι, ἀλλήλοις φθονοῦντες.
paragraphs.translit: mē ginōmetha kenodoxoi, allēlous prokaloumenoi, allēlois phthonountes.
